name: Bacon Protocol
fix_description: In lend (0xa6aa57ce), add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier). The function makes an external call before updating state, allowing recursive re-entry that mints excess shares. Apply checks-effects-interactions pattern or add a reentrancy lock.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit uses a flash swap from Uniswap plus protocol-specific reentrancy via ERC777/ERC1820-style tokensReceived hooks to recursively call lend before redeeming, so it requires understanding multiple contracts and token callback mechanics. The PoC is still fairly short, but it is more than a trivial single-step bug and needs DeFi-specific reasoning about flash liquidity and callback-driven state abuse.
